title: Why does the Moon seem to change shape?
practice: Explore more astronomy and everyday science in Science Quiz.

sections.html:
A thin crescent and a full Moon can look like different objects, but the Moon itself has not changed shape. We are seeing different amounts of its sunlit half as it orbits Earth.

The Sun lights roughly half of the Moon. The positions of the Sun, Earth and Moon determine how much of that bright half faces us. Those changing views are the Moon’s phases.

Earth’s shadow causes a lunar eclipse. It does not cause the ordinary monthly phases.
sections.title: One Moon, changing views

sections.html:
At first quarter, half of the Moon’s visible disc looks bright. The name refers to its position about a quarter of the way through the phase cycle, rather than the fraction we see lit.

Waxing means the illuminated portion we see is growing. Waning means it is shrinking.

The bright side can appear differently oriented depending on where you are, so watching the change over several nights is more useful than memorising a left-or-right rule.
sections.title: Why a half-lit Moon is called a quarter

sections.html:
When you can see the Moon, make a quick sketch and note the time. Repeat on another clear evening. Is the bright portion growing or shrinking?

The Moon will not be in the same place each night, and it may not be visible at your chosen time. A few observations are enough to start noticing the change.
sections.title: Follow the phases for a few nights

sections.html:
Does a crescent Moon appear because Earth blocks some of its sunlight?

No. A crescent is our view of a small part of the sunlit half. Earth’s shadow is involved in a lunar eclipse, not an ordinary crescent phase.

questions.prompt: What normally causes the Moon’s monthly phases?
options: Our changing view of its sunlit half
questions.explanation: The Moon orbits Earth, changing how much of its sunlit half faces us. Earth’s shadow causes a lunar eclipse, not the ordinary phases.

options: The visible illuminated portion is growing
The Moon is moving closer every night
The visible illuminated portion is shrinking
questions.explanation: Waxing describes a growing illuminated portion as seen from Earth.

questions.prompt: At first quarter, approximately how much of the visible lunar disc is illuminated?
questions.explanation: First quarter names the position in the phase cycle. Half the visible disc looks illuminated.
